queries: select category, date_trunc('week',order_date) w, count(*) n, round(avg(is_late::int),2) late, round(avg(is_short::int),2) short, round(avg(delay_days),1) d from purchase_order where order_date>='2025-02-10' and order_date<'2025-04-14' group by 1,2 order by 1,2

select category, supplier_id, case when order_date<'2025-03-03' then 'pre' else 'post' end per, count(*) n, round(avg(is_late::int),2) late, round(avg(is_short::int),2) short from purchase_order group by 1,2,3 order by 1,2,3
select p.category, date_trunc('week',l.date) w, count(*) n from lost_sale l join product p on p.id=l.product_id group by 1,2 order by 2,1
select id, category, supplier_id from product order by 1
